formulation: topical cream 0.3%, cream 0.15%, cream 0.05% and foam 0.3%, reported on one brand line
moa: phosphodiesterase-4 (PDE4) inhibitor, per the company's description of ZORYVE as a highly potent and selective PDE4 inhibitor

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 215985 ... Zoryve (roflumilast) cream, 0.3% ... This NDA provides for the use of Zoryve (roflumilast) cream, 0.3% for topical treatment of plaque psoriasis (signed SHARI L TARGUM 07/29/2022)

launch_evidence.quote: We commercially launched ZORYVE in August 2022 after obtaining FDA approval for the treatment of plaque psoriasis

series_start_reason: Arcutis first prints a product revenue line in the third quarter of 2022, the quarter ZORYVE launched (August 2022); the 2022Q2 release has no product revenue line.
notes: The 'Product revenue, net' line is total ZORYVE net product revenue, all formulations (2026Q2 release splits it as cream 0.3% 35.3, cream 0.15% 24.2, cream 0.05% 2.9 and foam 67.4, USD millions). Scope is U.S. only for 2022Q3-2023Q1; Health Canada approval was announced in the Q1 2023 release with launch 'in the coming weeks', so Canada enters the line from about 2023Q2 and is small. The issuer does not split the line by country. License revenue is on a separate line and excluded. The 2026Q1 figure is from the Form 10-Q (the 2026-05-06 8-K carries Item 9.01 only). Calendar quarters throughout.
